$comment: Copy this directory to <your-repo>/.claude/precheck/ and edit. Everything here is optional; delete what you don't need. With no .claude/precheck/ at all, precheck runs all six reviewers with generic rules.

codex.$comment: Codex-backed reviewers: each key is a dimension name, value is a prompt file path (resolved relative to repo root, then .claude/precheck/). Requires codex CLI installed. Only works with /precheck-wf. Prompt files support @path includes. Optional $model/$effort override codex CLI defaults (e.g. "$model": "gpt-5.5", "$effort": "medium").

custom.name: accessibility
custom.instructions: You review UI changes for accessibility: missing labels/alt text, color-contrast issues, focus order, and keyboard/screen-reader support. Only flag real, observable problems in the changed code.
